value.rationale: PASS: The least order of breakdown is a natural, motivating invariant for the explicit 2023 open question about whether the initial mode jumps from zero to k for all orders. Establishing k=15 as first failure requires controlling every lower order and all infinitely many modal competitors at real intensities; the index 25 and narrow rational transition bracket identify the actual alternative mechanism. This is a motivated sharp finite cutoff, not a routine renaming, an arbitrary isolated case, or a known-table transcription. Later modal phases and higher orders remain unproved.
